'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Mark Walseth LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|VB4-L-carefulplanning-pre.gif|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
